name: Business Hours Gate
description: Silently drops or canned-replies inbound messages during configured business hours so human staff handle them.

windows.description: Active windows when human staff handles the channel; AI replies are gated.

replyText.description: Optional canned reply during active windows. Empty / omitted = silent (no reply at all).

channels.description: Restrict gating to specific channels (e.g. ["line"]). Empty / omitted = all channels.

pauseAi.description: Master kill switch. When true, claim every inbound message regardless of schedule (always silent / canned). When false (default), schedule controls when to claim.

mccEnvFile.description: Path to Mission Control's env file, read for AUTH_SECRET so the plugin can send the X-Internal-Token that MCC's /api/* guard has required since v0.3.84. Defaults to ~/.mission-control/.env.local.

allowSlashCommands.description: Slash commands allowed through the customer-side block (e.g. ["/reset"]). Matched on the first whitespace-delimited token, case-insensitive.
